column1: # FIRO_SPACE rule curve. One row per day of a generic (non-leap) year.
# Unlimited FIRO space at Fall Creek and Fern Ridge through 31 October for use in testing the max potential of a delayed drawdown space component. Just for testing.
# from the rule curves of Flood_64_Temp1Day_2026-09-28.
# Rerun the generator rather than editing by hand.
#   FIRO = Rule Curve + 10% x (max con - Rule Curve)
# max con is the top of each reservoir's rule curve. In winter FIRO sits
# 10% of the conservation band above the rule curve
# rule curve when the pool is full.
# A BLANK cell means NO TARGET that day: the rule stands down and the rest
# of the rule stack operates the project. A project with no column here is
# never controlled. Column headers are matched to ResSim reservoir names
